description: Geohazardi is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ispu.mgipu.hr. Spatial layers in the Geohazardi group were made within the framework of the "Study on seismically induced effects of the Petrinja earthquake series 2020-2021. Coverage: HR. Its keywords include područja nepovoljna za gradnju, Petrinja, podložnost, rizici, klizišta, podzemne vode. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
